description: This file defines the ResponseCollectorActor class, an Akka actor responsible for collecting a fixed number of command responses and handling timeouts and exceptions within a messaging system of the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: ResponseCollectorActor
classes.description: An Akka actor that collects a fixed number of command responses, detects timeouts, and reports the collected responses or errors to the original query sender.

classes.name: ResponseCollectorActor.Output
classes.description: A data class encapsulating the responses collected by the ResponseCollectorActor, providing methods to analyze response statuses.

classes.name: ResponseCollectorActor.Input
classes.description: A marker interface for input messages to the ResponseCollectorActor.

classes.name: ResponseCollectorActor.Query
classes.description: Singleton enum used as a message to trigger a response query.

classes.name: ResponseCollectorActor.SetCount
classes.description: Message class to set the expected number of responses for the collector actor.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Defines how the actor handles different incoming messages.

methods.name: onReceiveTimeout
methods.description: Handles the receive timeout event by reporting the collected responses.

methods.name: onQuery
methods.description: Handles a query message, recording the sender and checking if responses are complete.

methods.name: onSetCount
methods.description: Handles setting the number of expected responses.

methods.name: onCommandResponse
methods.description: Handles incoming command responses by adding them to the collection.

methods.name: onDittoRuntimeException
methods.description: Handles runtime exceptions, recording the error and triggering a report.

methods.name: reportIfAllCollected
methods.description: Checks if all responses or errors are collected and triggers reporting.

methods.name: reportOutputAndStop
methods.description: Reports the collected responses and stops the actor.

methods.name: reportAndStop
methods.description: Sends the output to the original query sender and stops the actor.
